issue_title: Homepage performance dropped below 85 (90 → 79, LCP +781 ms, TBT +108 ms)
issue_body:
# Homepage performance regression — 2026-08-29

**Audit timestamp:** 2026-08-29T13:51:11.635Z
**Previous audit:** 2026-08-28T20:14:27.486Z (~18 h ago)

## What changed

| Metric | Previous | Current | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Performance | 90 | **79** | −11 pts |
| LCP | 3 278 ms | **4 059 ms** | +781 ms |
| TBT | 141 ms | **249 ms** | +108 ms |
| CLS | 0.015 | 0.015 | — |

The homepage crossed two thresholds simultaneously: performance dropped more than 5 points **and** fell below 85. LCP regressed by ~780 ms and TBT nearly doubled, suggesting either a new render-blocking resource, a larger/unoptimized hero asset, or a slow third-party fetch landed between the two audits.

## Recommended actions

1. **Diff recent deploys** — check what changed on `/` between ~20:14 UTC yesterday and ~13:51 UTC today (new image, script, or third-party tag).
2. **Audit hero image** — ensure the hero image is WebP, sized at display dimensions, and has `fetchpriority="high"` + an `<link rel="preload">` in `<head>`.
3. **Reduce TBT** — defer or code-split any non-critical JS that may be blocking the main thread; 249 ms TBT is approaching the "needs improvement" threshold.
4. **Apply same treatment to project detail pages** — `/projects/note-structurer` (79) and `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` (74) remain persistently below 85 with LCPs above 4 s; converting their thumbnail images to WebP at display size and lazy-loading below-fold assets should help.

## Not actionable this audit
- All non-performance Lighthouse dimensions (accessibility, best-practices, SEO) remain perfect at 100 across all pages.
- No visual breakage detected on any page (desktop or mobile).
